title: Inventory Swap
description: This plugin swaps your inventory with another player every 1 minute!
body:
This plugin swaps your inventory with another random player's every minute! 

The timer shows up above your hotbar so you can find some strategies.

Have fun! Super fun minigame, especially when added with other plugins/mods. [see my page!]

I may make it so you can change the time at a later date - show some support :)
